goalTemplateWithoutId.title: Rekombination bei der Meiose am Chromosomenmodell erläutern
goalTemplateWithoutId.titleEn: Explain recombination during meiosis using a chromosome model
goalTemplateWithoutId.description: Die lernende Person kann an vorgegebenen Meiose-Chromosomenmodellen erläutern, wie die voneinander unabhängige Verteilung der mütterlichen und väterlichen Chromosomen verschiedener Paare sowie der Austausch entsprechender Abschnitte zwischen Nichtschwesterchromatiden neue Kombinationen der Erbinformation in Keimzellen erzeugen.
goalTemplateWithoutId.descriptionEn: The learner can use supplied chromosome models of meiosis to explain how the independent assortment of maternally and paternally inherited chromosomes from different pairs and the exchange of corresponding segments between non-sister chromatids produce new combinations of genetic information in gametes.

provenance.sourceLandscapeTitle: DE-NI - Biologie Sekundarstufe I (Niedersachsen, KC 2015 Source-Extraction)

sourceBinding.sourceText: erläutern auf der Grundlage der Meiose die Prinzipien der Rekombination.
sourceBinding.curricularInterpretation: Chromosomal-model explanation; independent assortment and chromatid-segment exchange are the chosen biological interpretation of principles. The original bullet does not explicitly name these mechanisms; neither a molecular mechanism nor independently constructed model is inferred.

providedModelContextRequired: Correct labelled homologous pairs with maternal/paternal origin, chromosome/chromatid legend and correspondence of segments.
At least two distinct homologous pairs and correctly given alternative orientations/outcomes show pairwise independent assortment.
A separately supplied correct chromosome comparison shows a corresponding segment exchanged between non-sister chromatids and the resulting recombined chromosomes.
Model outputs preserve one chromosome of each type in the gamete and all corresponding genetic regions; new combinations are distinguished from extra/missing chromosomes.
Models and relevant terminology are supplied; learner explains the relation between process and new combination, rather than independently constructing a meiosis model.
prerequisiteRationale: Existing plant/animal-cell comparison provides cellular context. All chromosome-specific representation conventions and model data are supplied. The broad existing Mitose und Meiose goal is neither rewritten nor made a mandatory full mitosis/meiosis algorithm prerequisite.
outOfScope: Independent model construction or drawing from memory
Molecular crossing-over/repair, DNA sequence or protein-synthesis mechanisms
Recombination frequencies, genetic maps, probabilistic calculations or a2^n routine
Trisomy21/nondisjunction as a surrogate for recombination
